actions.sql: SELECT d.bucket_label, e.grp_key, MIN(e.payload) AS sample_payload, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wide_events e JOIN bucket_dim d ON d.bucket_id = e.bucket_id WHERE e.status = 1 GROUP BY d.bucket_label, e.grp_key ORDER BY d.bucket_label, e.grp_key

metadata.root_cause: Wide grouped columns plus TEXT in the result force internal temp tables toward on-disk storage.
